description: Save a recipe to the user's box in ONE call: one written in chat, pasted, from a photo/file, or from import_from_url. Saves right away; don't ask questions first. Gaps get defaults (4 servings, private; filing inferred); afterwards tell the user the `assumed` items in one line. If this recipe is an open draft, pass draft_id. Blocked on read-only accounts. Returns {id, title, filed, assumed}.

description.description: One or two sentences about the dish, max 2000 chars

diet.description: Diet labels only as the user stated them, e.g. ["Vegetarian"]

draft_id.description: Open draft id from start_recipe_draft to save into (avoids a duplicate)

family_group_id.description: Group id (from manage_family list) when visibility is family

ingredients.description: Lines like "2 cups flour, sifted" or {quantity, unit, item, note, group}; replaces the whole list

menu_entry_id.description: Menu slot to fill once saved

servings.description: Number of servings the amounts make, e.g. 4 (default 4 on save)

source_url.description: Original web page URL, if any

steps.description: Strings or {text, timer_minutes, temp_f}; replaces the whole list

title.description: Dish name, max 200 chars, e.g. "Lemon Garlic Chicken"

visibility.description: private = only the user; family = shared with family_group_id. Default: the user's sharing default

name: save_recipe
title: Save a recipe
